traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet. This combination is modern/cyclic only.

modern.blend: Expansion meets disruption. Attraction to unconventional ideas and systems of thought.
modern.harmonious: Seen as forward-thinking and ahead of the curve; you get away with it.
modern.hard: Seen as eccentric or a crank, no matter the merit of the idea.
modern.business: Innovative thinking whose reception depends heavily on how it's framed.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
